findings.summary: seven of the ten changed files lie outside the node's declared exclusive write paths; the edits are implied by the goal but the coordinator must ratify the extra paths rather than treat the fence as satisfied

classes the done_when says must be recorded terminal through an existing terminal writer are instead only classified as run-terminal by the census, writing nothing to the graph; the choice preserves the hold for sn rescore but leaves the reason in the census result rather than on the identity

raw_text:
VERDICT goal: the node goal is that every stranded identity class with attempts under its cap is claimable by exactly one worker pool; imas_codex/standard_names/pools.py:455 makes the six pool predicates one shared, mutually exclusive condition set and the census drops from 368 stranded identities to zero.
VERDICT done_when: the done_when names tests/standard_names/test_stranded_identity_admission.py, a read-only live census before and after, and a sib-stranded-pool-admission.html class table carrying count, intended owner and base refusal for all 85 classes; all three are present in the diff and their results are recorded in the manifest's baseline_suite, after_suite and live-baseline-wired/live-head-delivered.json.
VERDICT write_paths: the manifest declares four exclusive paths (pools.py, the admission test, the evidence fragment, a figures directory); the diff changes those three plus imas_codex/cli/sn.py, five imas_codex/standard_names/graph_store modules and tests/standard_names/test_stranded_identity_census.py, all recorded honestly in changed_paths but outside the fence.
VERDICT manifest: read; it states the gate result (13 failed / 8631 passed baseline, 13 failed / 8639 passed at head, zero added ids), the 73-passed focused arm, the 5-failed negative control at negative-control-1310730.log, and the live census 368->0 with 136 terminal-for-run.
VERDICT diff: read commit by commit from d500e8eab to 5e0d8e86 across six commits; it replaces five separately hand-written Cypher admission predicates with one dual in-memory/Cypher condition tree in pools.py, routes every claim and pending query through it, and adds deterministic pre-review validation.
CALL_SITES: imas_codex/cli/sn.py:_compute_pool_progress, imas_codex/standard_names/graph_store/graph_cost_and_claims.py:claim_review_name_batch, imas_codex/standard_names/graph_store/graph_docs_persistence.py:claim_generate_docs_batch, imas_codex/standard_names/graph_store/graph_docs_persistence.py:claim_refine_docs_batch, imas_codex/standard_names/graph_store/graph_refinement.py:claim_refine_name_batch, imas_codex/standard_names/graph_store/graph_review_persistence.py:claim_review_docs_batch, imas_codex/standard_names/graph_store/graph_parent_lifecycle.py:pool_pending_counts, imas_codex/standard_names/loop.py:classify_identity_state_groups
SCORE goal_fidelity: 18
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: imas_codex/standard_names/pools.py:455 renders every pool from one shared exclusion set and the census at imas_codex/standard_names/pools.py:845 moves the remaining classes to a named run-terminal reason, leaving zero stranded with zero overlap.
SCORE evidence: 17
JUSTIFICATION evidence: the receipt suites are recorded in suite-baseline-wired.log and suite-head-delivered.log with the same 13 ids, and the live pair live-baseline-wired.json/live-head-delivered.json records stranded 368->0, though the done_when's "existing terminal writer" clause is met by a census classification rather than a write (imas_codex/standard_names/pools.py:845).
SCORE scope_discipline: 6
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: only imas_codex/standard_names/pools.py, tests/standard_names/test_stranded_identity_admission.py and the evidence fragment are inside the declared paths; imas_codex/cli/sn.py and five graph_store modules are outside them.
SCORE durability: 18
JUSTIFICATION durability: tests/standard_names/test_stranded_identity_admission.py:279 asserts stranded_count == 0 against the independently hand-maintained _RECORDED_OWNERS table, and the declared rollback in negative-control-1310730.log reddens it with "assert 43 == 0".
SCORE fit: 16
JUSTIFICATION fit: the change follows the module idiom of imas_codex/standard_names/graph_store/graph_refinement.py:119 and introduces no forbidden name, but imports the private _validate_claimed_review_candidates across a module boundary at imas_codex/standard_names/graph_store/graph_cost_and_claims.py:14.
SCORE reuse: 19
JUSTIFICATION reuse: the change consolidates five duplicated admission Cypher strings into the single owner at imas_codex/standard_names/pools.py:470 and delegates validation to the existing worker_compose_and_validate.validate_name_candidate rather than forking it.
FINDING imas_codex/cli/sn.py:586 non-blocking: seven of the ten changed files lie outside the node's declared exclusive write paths; the edits are implied by the goal but the coordinator must ratify the extra paths rather than treat the fence as satisfied.
FINDING imas_codex/standard_names/pools.py:845 non-blocking: classes the done_when says must be recorded terminal through an existing terminal writer are instead only classified as run-terminal by the census, writing nothing to the graph; the choice preserves the hold for sn rescore but leaves the reason in the census result rather than on the identity.
FINDING imas_codex/standard_names/graph_store/graph_cost_and_claims.py:14 non-blocking: a private _-prefixed helper is imported from imas_codex/standard_names/pools.py into a graph_store module, so the admission package's private surface is now a cross-module contract that a rename would break silently.
